name: pin-and-badge-verifier-parity
description: Cross-language parity for the offline employee verifier (spec 03 §2.3, BAN-397). The server emits these verifiers for a known device_secret and known PIN/badge; the client MUST reproduce the exact same hex or offline login is impossible. Read by BOTH tests/Feature/BootstrapTest.php and resources/js/shared/auth/pin.test.ts. Regenerate with `php tests/fixtures/auth/generate.php`.

deviceSecretDerivation.note: device_secret = HMAC-SHA256(base64_decode(appKey without the base64: prefix), "restopos:device-secret:"+deviceUuid). Lets the PHP suite reproduce device_secret through the real DeviceTokenService instead of mocking a final class. The TS suite ignores these and consumes deviceSecret directly. See tests/fixtures/auth/generate.php.
